imageContext:
Image alt: This graphic is a two column chart titled “Employee Relationships.” The column on the left is titled “Employees” and the bulleted points are full-time; single employer; benefits; and employment taxes are split between employee and employer. The column on the right is titled “Non-employees (Contractors, Freelancers, Gig workers)” and the bulleted points are part-time; multiple employers (clients); no benefits; and employment taxes must be paid entirely by employee.

English caption: Figure 10.8 Different models of work include widely varying terms and conditions, but the two most basic divisions are listed.
